name: Aviary Buy Wall AMM
description: A port of IMD's Pool4 design. Each market pairs a token with wrapped SOL on a constant-product curve that owns all its liquidity: seeded once, with no LP shares and no way to take liquidity out. An inventory cap trims the curve when sells leave it holding too many tokens; trimmed tokens are burned except for the market's reward share, and trimmed SOL becomes a buy wall below the price. Every swap pays the market's fee in SOL, split between IMD and Adam, the suite and the market. Nobody controls a market after its seed. A launchpad graduating a token can create and seed a market in one call through pipeline_seed_liquidity. This build opens markets, trades them exact-in through the curve and the buy wall, keeps the inventory cap and lets anyone place the wall; settling the retired tokens, paying rewards and sweeping fees arrive in later builds.

init.description: Creates a market for a token against wrapped SOL. Seed it with the seed action in the same transaction; its parameters never change after creation.

args.label: Share of the market's fee for the buy wall (basis points)

args.name: fee_recipient
args.label: Fee recipient
args.description: Receives the market's part of the fee that does not go to the buy wall. Leave unset only when the wall takes all of it.

args.name: reward_share_bps
args.label: Reward share of trimmed tokens (basis points)

args.name: rewards_recipient
args.label: Rewards recipient

args.name: cap_floor_bps
args.label: Cap floor (basis points of the seeded tokens)

args.name: cap_decay_bps
args.label: Cap decay a day (basis points of the seeded tokens)
args.description: How far buys may lower the inventory cap each day. 0 switches the ratchet off.

args.name: seeder
args.label: Seeder
args.description: The only wallet that may seed the market.

seed_liquidity.description: For a launchpad graduating a token: its program calls pipeline_seed_liquidity, which creates a market for the token against wrapped SOL, takes the seed from the launchpad's escrows and opens it, all in one call. SeedRequest.amounts is exactly two amounts, the tokens then the wrapped SOL to take, under the same rules as the seed action: the token's mint and freeze authorities removed, at least the program's MIN_SEED_LAMPORTS, and an opening price inside the bounds. SeedRequest.data is these arguments, Borsh-encoded in order, exactly as init's: the same creation parameters under the same rules, except the seeder, which is the calling program's PDA that signs and owns both escrows. Accounts: Pipeline's fixed seed accounts (the seeder, the market state below, the payer, the system program and an LP recipient, which is ignored since a buy wall market issues no LP shares), then mint, escrow and token program for the token and then for wrapped SOL, then the accounts below, then the token's transfer-hook accounts. Returns SeedResult with lp_amount 0. Follow it in the same transaction with the router's register_existing_market (no info accounts after the market state) and init_fee_account for each mint. The market state is keyed by the seeder and the token, so a seeder seeds each token once and another seeder of the same token gets another market. The seed stays in the market for good: there is no withdrawal.

actions.name: seed
actions.label: Seed the market
actions.description: Seeds and opens the market, once, signed by its seeder, from the seeder's own token and wrapped SOL accounts. The token's mint and freeze authorities must be removed first. The seed stays in the market for good: there is no withdrawal. A token with a transfer hook needs the hook's accounts after these, which this form cannot add.

actions.name: place_wall
actions.label: Place the buy wall
actions.description: A keeper job anyone may run. Closes the buy wall at the current price and places it again with all the market's idle SOL, below the price at the lower of the price and the wall's floor, which rises only slowly after a pump, so a pumped price earns nothing. Refused until the market's idle SOL, or the SOL the placed wall has spent buying tokens, reaches the program's WALL_THRESHOLD. Tips the caller in wrapped SOL to their own wrapped SOL account, which must exist: at most the program's KEEPER_TIP_CAP and never more than the market's fee on that SOL. It never moves the price.
